_doc: Labels for code points without a character name, by range (hex, inclusive). Rendered as <label-XXXX>. 'noncharacter_tail' covers U+xFFFE/U+xFFFF in every plane. Anything else unassigned renders as U+XXXX. 'hidden_kind_labels' are the short box labels for non-visible characters without a Unicode abbreviation, by kind from src/data/visibility.json.
